decisions.reason: Although it was not recently observed on the website, this security architecture is tightly linked to the firm's core authentication and cryptography platform and is more likely to be retained or embedded than abandoned.
As a narrowly scoped delivery tool that has not been visible on the website for two years, it is likely to be withdrawn as a standalone product and folded into broader secure communication offerings.
Payment-security compliance still fits the firm's regulated-enterprise positioning, but weaker recent visibility suggests some risk of later consolidation into the broader product portfolio.
